svg.aria-label: When should an AI trust its first answer? It fails: A first draft can be too short, drift off the question or stop mid-thought, and nothing says so. It catches: Each draft is scored with simple quality rules; below the required quality, one more attempt with tighter settings. Limit: Repair is an attempt, not a guarantee; both repaired answers stayed below the requirement.
